title: Onboard Aquarius-13B v1.0: perf profiles, metadata, and changelog automation
author: Maya Patel
description: Onboard Aquarius-13B v1.0 into the model registry with complete metadata, performance profiles for supported hardware families, and automated changelog/release notes integration. Motivation: Aquarius is a promising open model that matches our target latency/quality tradeoffs for mid-size batch NLP workloads; onboarding it enables customers to select a cost-efficient 13B option. This PR includes: 1) models/aquarius/metadata.yaml with canonical fields (model_id, version, architecture, tokenizer, license, upstream_url, validation_prompts); 2) perf_profiles JSON covering p3, g4dn, and A100 GPU families with measured tokens/sec and tail-latency SLOs; 3) generation hook for changelog automation that inserts a standardized release note entry into changelog/_auto/ based on metadata tags; 4) lightweight validation tests that run profile sanity checks and metadata schema validation; 5) docs update to registry onboarding guide referencing new Aquarius entry. Checklist: - [x] Add metadata.yaml with required fields and test vectors - [x] Add perf_profiles and accompanying measurement notes - [x] Wire changelog generator to registry CI job (changelog generation is opt-in) - [x] Add unit tests and CI config changes - [x] Get perf review and sign-off - [x] Update docs and release notes Note: perf numbers are best-effort measured on our perf-lab. We include quantized fallback profiles for 4-bit and 8-bit inference and a recommended default profile. Referenced Linear tickets: ENG-2345 (onboarding pipeline), PM-112 (product acceptance). Related: pr-164321 (lucent onboarding) for metadata schema examples.
commits: Add perf_profiles for p3/g4dn/A100 and quantized fallbacks
Implement changelog generator hook and CI job
Add tests for metadata schema and perf sanity
Address review feedback: tighten license field validation and doc copy
review_comments: Liam Chen: Can you include tail-latency p99 numbers for the A100 profile? Response: added p99s and clarified measurement harness in notes.
Sofia Martinez: License field looks like a URL in upstream metadata; prefer SPDX identifier. Response: updated license to 'Apache-2.0' and preserved upstream_url.
Rajesh Kumar: Suggest adding quantized fallback profile notes and recommended default. Response: added 4-bit/8-bit sections and recommended default profile in perf_profiles.json.
Infra CI: discovered intermittent failure on perf sanity test in arm perf lab; added retry and timeout guard.
release_notes: Added Aquarius-13B v1.0 to the model registry with performance profiles for p3/g4dn/A100, quantized fallback recommendations, and automated changelog generation entry. This enables customers to select Aquarius-13B with validated latency and throughput guidance.
summary: Onboard Aquarius-13B v1.0: metadata, perf profiles across supported hardware, changelog automation hook, tests, and docs updates. CI passed and perf reviewers approved; merged to main via squash.
